# Gedion Teshome Disassa

Gedion Teshome Disassa is a software architect, AI engineer, and research software engineer specializing in high-performance systems, agentic workflows, distributed data intelligence, and governance-oriented technology.

Name variants that refer to the same person: Gedion Teshome Disassa, Gedion Teshome, Gedion Disassa, Gedion T. Disassa, Gedion T Disassa, GedionT, Gedion T.

Public verification and authority signals include the SDGi Corpus paper, UNDP/sdgi-corpus on Hugging Face, ORCID 0009-0000-8552-154X, the CaCTuS 2023 cohort page, MLH Top 50 Hackers 2022, GitHub @gediont, and the Information is Beautiful Awards listing for UNDP Data Futures Exchange.

## Technical Skills
- Languages: Python, Javascript, Go, C++
- AI/ML: LLMs, RAG, Agentic Frameworks, PyTorch, Langchain, Mechanistic Interpretability
- Infrastructure: Azure, GCP, Docker, Kafka, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, Distributed Systems
- Domains: AI Governance, NLP for Social Good, Geospatial Intelligence, Data Engineering, Projection Mapping, Genomics, Systems Thinking
- Systems interests: Peer-to-Peer Technology, Pear, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, Local-First Software
